title: A Single-Link Multi-Domain-Output (SLiMDO) Isolated DC-DC Converter with Passive Magnetic Flux Sharing for Local Energy Distribution and Rx Behavior Sensing-Based Global Power Modulation
problem: Galvanically isolated DC-DC converters with multiple domain-specific outputs require separate control signals across isolation barriers and custom interconnect topologies, increasing complexity and requiring digital isolators for Tx-Rx communication.
motivation: Industrial systems (motor drives, battery management, gate drivers) increasingly demand multiple isolated outputs at different domains without costly per-output control infrastructure.
method: Single-link topology using passive magnetic flux sharing and receiver-side behavior sensing for global power modulation, eliminating need for digital isolators and enabling flexible domain-specific output configuration.
key_novelty: Passive magnetic flux sharing with Rx-side sensing-based global power modulation eliminating cross-isolation control signals.
contributions: Passive magnetic flux sharing reducing area and cost
Receiver-side power sensing enabling Tx control without isolators
Flexible domain isolation and output configuration
primary_theme: Multi-domain isolated power delivery with passive control
